verdict.rationale: First-party docs say OpenClaw can run a dedicated Chrome/Brave/Edge/Chromium profile that the agent controls, and describe agent-controlled browser automation. Release notes list live browser automation, and the product describes itself as an assistant for browser workflows. The computer-use tool also lets the agent see and control a desktop, which gives a second path to driving a browser. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the navigate, log-in, click and extract actions, details on session and credential handling for logged-in sites, and independent or hands-on confirmation that browser control works on live pages.
